purpose: Source-level golden guard for printable document rendering. A hash change requires explicit visual/PDF review and deliberate baseline regeneration.

changes.reason: ADR-013: WHT receipts (หัก ณ ที่จ่าย) clipped the WHT / net-cash rows, WHT note and amount in words in Chromium print/PDF; CSS rules scoped to .rcp-doc-totals-wht compact only WHT receipts. Reviewed as PDF (html2canvas + jsPDF, Chromium): WHT receipts show all 5 total rows; receipts without WHT are pixel-identical. Render functions unchanged.

ADR-021: (1) ประกาศอธิบดีฯ VAT ฉบับที่ 199 — the buyer's establishment ("สำนักงานใหญ่" / "สาขาที่ xxxxx", from invoice.customerBranchCode) is printed after the buyer tax ID on every copy of the full tax invoice; (2) a cancelled invoice prints a "ยกเลิก / CANCELLED" stamp with the reason. Both are inline additions that add no bytes when empty: the preview HTML of all 62 seeded invoice/receipt pages with the fields stripped (records saved before ADR-021) is byte-identical to round8-base. Reviewed as Chromium print PDFs (branch buyer, HQ buyer, no-VAT, abbreviated, cancelled). CSS and documentPagesHtml unchanged; abbreviated layout unchanged.

ADR-021: the receipt shows the buyer tax ID, so the buyer's establishment is printed after it like on the tax invoice; a cancelled receipt prints the "ยกเลิก / CANCELLED" stamp. Empty fields add no bytes (old records byte-identical). Reviewed as Chromium print PDF. CSS unchanged.

regeneratedEntries.justification: Language audit (Notification 199 / RD form wording): "เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษีอากร", "ชื่อลูกค้า", sentence-case English labels (Salesperson, Payment terms, Subtotal, Grand total, Approved by, Prepared by, Delivered by, For office use, Ordered by), amount-in-words label "จำนวนเงิน (ตัวอักษร) / Amount in words" (3 short lines, fits the 12 % column). Tax audit: MED-4 0 % row "ภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่ม 0% / VAT 0%" + export declaration no. on zero-rated sales; MED-3 replacement line "ออกแทนใบกำกับภาษีเลขที่ … ลงวันที่ …"; MED-6 service invoice with the tax point at payment prints as "ใบแจ้งหนี้" + the ม.78/1 notice. Totals, layout and pagination unchanged; Thai-mode output of existing records differs only in these labels.

Language audit: removed the contradictory "โปรดชำระเงินเข้าบัญชี…" line on a paid receipt (H9), RD wording "เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษีอากร", "หนังสือรับรองการหักภาษี ณ ที่จ่าย", "ผู้รับเงิน / Collector", sentence-case labels, amount-in-words label, the bilingual validity box marked data-bilingual. Tax audit MED-6: the receipt of a service invoice issued with the tax point at payment prints as "ใบเสร็จรับเงิน/ใบกำกับภาษี" with THIS payment's value/VAT and a ม.78/1 note. Totals of ordinary receipts unchanged.

Multi-currency print: a tax invoice in a currency without the Director-General approval prints in baht with a "ข้อมูลประกอบ (ไม่ใช่ยอดตามใบกำกับภาษี)" box (currency, rate, rate date); with the approval (or an export invoice of goods, ป.132/2548 ข้อ 6) the amounts print in the currency with the rate, the baht value and the baht VAT. The branches are taken only for records with a foreign currency and use inline styles (CSS unchanged). Every THB invoice of the sample (load 26 Oct 2569, both branches, original + copy) renders byte-identical to round13a-fixes.

Multi-currency print: a receipt in a currency prints the currency received, its baht at the receipt rate and, on the accounting / file copies, the receivable settled and the realised exchange difference (inline styles, CSS unchanged). Backlog fix (r13B item 8): the payment term follows the invoice — a credit invoice shows its term and ITS due date, a cash sale "เงินสด" with no due date (before: "เงินสด" with the print date as due date). The THB receipts of the sample differ from round13a-fixes only in those two cells (golden-identity.log lists every differing line).
